incidents.name: BTNFT transferFrom without approval check
incidents.notes: BTNFT.transferFrom() does not verify that the caller owns or is approved for the token, so the attacker moved every minted NFT to the contract and claimed the BUSD rewards attached to them.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x0FC91B6Fea2E7A827a8C99C91101ed36c638521B created 2025-01-03T11:19:22Z by 0x2c0b7b7d4884bb64caa0d2298900c558d84fc194, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xbda2a27cdb2ffd4258f3b1ed664ed0f28f9e0fc3; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
